title: Hudson x David weekly
notes_markdown:
### Priya pilot — root causes

- **Missing ~140 Claude chats:** confirmed — her export had 2 conversation files; importer only read the first. Fixed: glob all `conversations*.json`, merge by uuid. Re-ran on her export: 553 conversations.
- Also found: 4 conversations with empty `chat_messages` were silently dropped — now listed as skipped ("empty conversation")
- **Duplicate PDFs:** publisher vs arXiv versions; title match failed on subtitles and "(1)" filenames. New rule: normalize title (strip subtitle after colon only for matching), compare DOI when present, first-page text similarity as tie-break. Still suggest-don't-merge.
- **Suggestions:** collapse candidates that share a DOI or normalized title

### What worked

- First confirmed suggestion ~6 min into the writing task (Claude chat from March)
- Exclude-folders used immediately (IRB folder)
- Summary card understood without explanation

### What confused

- "Other" tile — Priya expected Obsidian/Notion there
- Proposal: rename to "Upload files"; add a separate "Request a source" tile that just collects votes

### Pilot B prep (Daniel Osei, Tue Oct 13, 9:00 PT / 12:00 ET)

- CMU postdoc; uses Notion heavily and Granola for meetings (per his intake form)
- Neither connector exists — be honest; use the request tile to record it
- Keep "Other" as-is for Daniel? — decided: keep, to see if confusion repeats (n=2 before renaming)

### Action items

- [ ] David — ship multi-file Claude import + dedupe rules to staging tonight
- [ ] Hudson — numbers for Marcus (Wed): pilots, imported items, time to first confirmed suggestion
- [ ] Hudson — schedule Priya follow-up (Oct 16 or 19)
